name: channel-web
title: Web chat: your users talk to the assistant from a page of their own (/chat/), with accounts
description: A chat page for people who are not operators: they sign in (email and password, a link by email, Google, GitHub or any OIDC platform), see and continue only their own conversations, watch the answer as it is written, attach images and stop a run. The operator invites, bans and removes them. On Cloudflare the Worker serves it, each conversation in its Durable Object, the accounts in one object.

channel-web.description: The web chat's users: channel-web users | invite <email> [--name <name>] | reset | ban | unban | remove <user id or email>

environment.name: CHANNEL_WEB_AUTH_SECRET
environment.description: What the users' sessions are signed with: at least 32 random characters (`openssl rand -base64 48`). Never the admin token. Changing it signs every user out.

environment.name: PIKIT_PUBLIC_URL
environment.description: The App's public origin (https://chat.example.com), when a proxy hides it: OAuth redirect URIs and the links of invitations and resets are made under it. Absent, each request's origin.
